name: Terai Tea Company Limited
summary: Terai Tea Company Limited primarily focuses on the cultivation and processing of tea. Additionally, the enterprise is involved in the commerce of commodities such as sugar, cotton yarn, and a range of textile products. Its operations are structured into two distinct divisions: the Tea Business and Agricultural Trading Income, and a separate Merchandise Trading segment. The company markets its products under several proprietary brands, including Terai King, Terai Queen, Terai Rungneet, Terai Monarch, Terai Maharaja, and Terai Snow View. Established on September 25, 1973, Terai Tea maintains its corporate headquarters in Siliguri, India.
